detail_gaps: Exact per-provider registry entries, authorization semantics, and legacy persistence schema must be confirmed against the eventual editor implementation; this contract deliberately does not infer them.
details_checked: Type defaults versus instance state versus diagram projections versus effective state versus documentation overrides
Mermaid graph syntax, stable IDs, dependencies, gates, states, and ledger correspondence
implementation_options: A — prune as default; retain only as an explicit inventory/export projection: Uniform cards falsely imply topology and do not scale.
B — retain as validated provider-adapter metadata, not a global allowlist: Curation is needed but must be versioned and intent-aware.
C — retain as the core classification mechanism: A testable semantic taxonomy enables shared renderers without false provider equivalence.
D — retain as projection presets layered over the taxonomy: Intent changes relevance but cannot replace resource semantics.
E — retain: A separate navigable inventory preserves completeness when the canvas is intentionally selective; stable resource IDs prevent duplicate truth.
F — retain only as constrained documentation override: Pinning serves documentation but cannot decide semantic defaults or create ports/traffic links.
G — select: Registry plus authoritative inventory plus intent-based projections is the smallest coherent model satisfying correctness, discoverability, context, and scale.
